schema:
CREATE TABLE stores (
  store_id integer,
  store_code text,
  geo_area_id integer,
  country_code text,
  country_name text,
  state text,
  opened_on date,
  closed_on date,
  description text,
  floor_area_m2 numeric,
  status text
);
CREATE TABLE products (
  product_id integer,
  product_code text,
  product_name text,
  manufacturer text,
  brand text,
  color text,
  weight_unit text,
  weight numeric,
  unit_cost numeric,
  unit_price numeric,
  category_id integer,
  category_name text,
  subcategory_id integer,
  subcategory_name text
);
CREATE TABLE calendar (
  calendar_date date,
  date_key integer,
  year integer,
  year_quarter text,
  year_quarter_number integer,
  quarter text,
  year_month text,
  year_month_short text,
  year_month_number integer,
  month_name text,
  month_short text,
  month_number integer,
  day_of_week text,
  day_of_week_short text,
  day_of_week_number integer,
  working_day boolean,
  working_day_number integer
);
CREATE TABLE exchange_rates (
  rate_date date,
  from_currency text,
  to_currency text,
  rate numeric
);
CREATE TABLE orders (
  order_id integer,
  customer_id integer,
  store_id integer,
  order_date date,
  delivery_date date,
  currency_code text
);
CREATE TABLE order_lines (
  order_id integer,
  line_number integer,
  product_id integer,
  quantity integer,
  unit_price numeric,
  net_price numeric,
  unit_cost numeric
);
CREATE TABLE customers (
  customer_id integer,
  gender text,
  title text,
  first_name text,
  middle_initial text,
  last_name text,
  city text,
  state_code text,
  state_name text,
  postal_code text,
  country_code text,
  country_name text,
  birth_date date,
  valid_from date,
  valid_to date
);
note: orders and order_lines are a 1-in-10 sample (order_id divisible by 10); customers are those on sampled orders; exchange_rates are USD-from only.
